thread:
zoe.sales: Heads-up — HelioCard just sent an RFI requesting a short POC plan, confirmation of S3 ingestion options, quantization support impact on accuracy, and commercial bullets. They attached the RFI: https://drive.company/heliocard_rfi_may.pdf. Who can take the infra/sec answers?

file-bot: Uploaded file `heliocard_rfi_may.pdf` (1.9MB) to #sales thread.

kai.eng: I can do infra. Quick clarifying Q: do they want an air-gapped option or just VPC peering? The doc mentions both.

zoe.sales: They said on the call they'd prefer peering for the POC but want air-gapped as an eventual option. POC timeline requested is 2-3 weeks.

lee.sec: Security notes: For any PHI/PII we need a signed DPA/BAA before ingestion. For hosted POC we support customer-managed KMS and tenant isolation; audit logs retained 30 days. For air-gapped/on-prem we require an SOW and network diagram. Presigned S3 URLs are allowed but must be read-only, scoped to objects, and rotated for repeated uploads.

ana.prod: Product input: We recommend a two-stage POC: Stage A hosted fp16 baseline (7-10 days) to validate integration and metrics; Stage B Dedicated quantized run (int8) to show cost/latency tradeoffs. Success metrics: embedding sim delta < 1.5%, p95 latency target, and no security exceptions.

matt.finance: Commercials: propose a one-time POC credit $7,200 covering hosted work and first 350GB of ingress/egress. Dedicated short trial commit starting at $16k/month (30-day min). Egress overage $0.10/GB. Support beyond included hours billed at $225/hr.

kai.eng: Draft pasteable snippets below — please edit before sending.

---
Ingestion: "Customer may upload data via presigned S3 URLs (recommended, TTL 24h) or provide a cross-account read-only IAM role; for air-gapped scenarios we accept encrypted offline media via an SOW."

Residency: "Hosted POC data is stored in the tenant's selected region. Private/VPC and on-prem deployments are available for strict residency requirements."

KMS/HSM: "Customer-managed KMS supported for hosted POCs. HSM/FIPS-140 key material supported in Private/on-prem deployments with a separate SOW and legal attestation."

Retention: "POC artifacts (logs, ephemeral caches) are retained 14 days by default; audit logs are retained 30 days. Shorter retention for sensitive data can be configured on request. A signed DPA/BAA is required before ingesting PHI/PII samples."

Egress/billing: "We cover the first 350GB of ingress/egress for the POC; additional egress billed at $0.10/GB. Private deployments follow the customer's cloud provider billing."

Example presign (for docs):
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://heliocard-incoming/batch1.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
```

Terraform snippet for cross-account role (example):
```hcl
resource \"aws_iam_role\" \"redwood_readonly\" {
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cross_account.json
}
```
---

lee.sec: Minor edits: presigned URLs must be read-only and scoped to individual objects; rotate tokens for multi-batch ingestion. Add security contact lee.sec@redwood.ai for questionnaire follow-ups. Also: when KMS is customer-managed, key policies must allow Redwood service principals (we can provide the minimal policy snippet).

ana.prod: Add KPI bullets: Latency SLO p50 < 120ms, p95 < 300ms for 4k token sequences on Dedicated; Throughput baseline 40 reqs/min for hosted POC; Quality: embedding similarity and a small QA eval suite run weekly during the POC.

matt.finance: Attachments list to include: pricing sheet (uploaded), DPA/BAA template, POC SOW template, and a short runbook. I'll upload pricing now.

file-bot: Uploaded file `heliocard_poc_pricing_v1.xlsx` (21KB) to #sales thread.

zoe.sales: Great — can someone produce a one-paragraph exec blurb I can paste into the RFI? Need this in the next 90 minutes.

ana.prod: Exec blurb: "Redwood proposes a focused 2-3 week POC with HelioCard to validate model integration, performance, and security controls. We will run a hosted fp16 baseline followed by an optional Dedicated quantized run to demonstrate cost/latency tradeoffs. Deliverables include KPI results, a findings report, and a recommended serving configuration with cost estimates."

zoe.sales: Perfect. Final checklist: 1) confirm presign + cross-account roles supported (kai) 2) confirm KMS wording + policy snippet (lee) 3) final POC credit & egress (matt) 4) attach pricing + DPA (done). Can we ship by EOD?

kai.eng: Confirmed presign and cross-account supported; we'll provide the Terraform snippet and minimal role ARN template.

lee.sec: KMS wording confirmed; will attach the minimal key policy and security addendum.

matt.finance: Numbers final. POC credit $7.2k, first 350GB included, overages $0.10/GB.

zoe.sales: Thanks team — assembling response now and sending to HelioCard. :rocket:
